title: Commercial Arithmetic: Shares, Tax and Loans
seo_title: Commercial Arithmetic – SSS 3 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Solve problems on compound interest, depreciation, shares and dividends, income tax, VAT, hire purchase, annuities and loans. (summary of the NERDC SSS 3 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free SSS 3 maths worksheets on commercial arithmetic in naira: compound interest, depreciation, shares and dividends, income tax, VAT, hire purchase and annuities. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Amount with compound interest = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ; depreciation uses (1 − r/100)ⁿ.
  • A dividend is the share of profit paid on the nominal value of shares.
  • Income tax is charged on the taxable income: income − allowances.

Examples

Example

1,000 shares of ₦2 at a 10% dividend

10% of ₦2,000

Answer: ₦200

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Using the market price for the dividendDividends are on the nominal value.
Taxing the whole incomeTake off the allowances first.
Simple interest in compound problemsMultiply by the multiplier each year.
